stories.headline: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse
stories.dek: Exclusive: Wyndham left a hardcoded credential in its customer app, allowing anyone to access customer data. The hotel giant wouldn't say if it has the ability to check for any past unauthorized access.
